requirement: Fresh initialization must create unified SQLite v2 schema with WAL mode, foreign keys, and single system subject, failing atomically with FileExistsError if target already exists.
precondition: Target database path does not exist in destination filesystem.
action: Call app.database.initialize(target) or python -m tools.migrate_v2 init --target app_v2.sqlite3
expected: Zero exit code, valid SQLite v2 database created with user_version=2, exactly one system subject '__system_unassigned__', and WAL journal mode.
observed: Database initialized atomically with user_version=2 and system subject.

requirement: Re-initialization conflict handling: target file already exists must raise FileExistsError without truncating or corrupting existing database file.
precondition: Target database file already exists on filesystem.
action: Invoke app.database.initialize(target) on existing database file.
expected: FileExistsError raised; original database file content and permissions unchanged.
observed: Database initialized atomically with user_version=2 and system subject.

requirement: create_schema executes full DDL script from schema_v2.sql; failure rollback leaves no partial or corrupt database schema.
precondition: Open SQLite connection to a fresh in-memory or empty database.
action: Invoke app.database.create_schema(conn).
expected: All 8 v2 tables (groups, subjects, topics, group_access, students, class_assignments, submissions, submission_files) created with proper constraints, indexes, and PRAGMA user_version=2.
observed: Database initialized atomically with user_version=2 and system subject.

requirement: Concurrent initialization race: when multiple threads/subprocesses attempt initialize() on the same target path simultaneously, exactly one succeeds and all others fail with FileExistsError.
precondition: Target path does not exist; 10 threads and 4 subprocesses concurrently invoke initialize().
action: Trigger simultaneous initialize(target) calls across threads and processes.
expected: Exactly one caller succeeds (creates valid v2 DB); all other callers raise FileExistsError; resulting DB passes validate() with exactly 1 system subject.
observed: Database initialized atomically with user_version=2 and system subject.

requirement: connect() context manager must configure row_factory=sqlite3.Row, PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000, and manage transactional commit/rollback via with conn.
precondition: Valid SQLite v2 database exists.
action: Enter with connect(path) as conn block, execute statements, and exit.
expected: FKs strictly enforced; busy_timeout set to 5000ms; unhandled exception inside context rolls back transaction; clean exit commits transaction.
observed: Foreign keys enabled, busy timeout 5000ms enforced, transactions isolated.

requirement: Lock timeout and concurrency: when database is locked by concurrent writer, connect() waits up to 5000ms before raising sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked.
precondition: Two connections to the same database; connection 1 begins an exclusive write transaction.
action: Connection 2 attempts write operation while Connection 1 holds lock.
expected: Connection 2 waits and succeeds if lock released within 5000ms; raises OperationalError if lock held >5000ms; no data loss or file corruption.
observed: Foreign keys enabled, busy timeout 5000ms enforced, transactions isolated.

requirement: Transaction isolation and visibility: uncommitted writes from an active transaction are not visible to separate read connections until COMMIT; rollback completely undoes changes.
precondition: Active connection inside uncommitted write transaction.
action: Separate read connection queries modified table during write transaction and after rollback.
expected: Reader sees only committed rows; rollback restores database state completely.
observed: Foreign keys enabled, busy timeout 5000ms enforced, transactions isolated.

requirement: validate() must raise DatabaseNotFoundError when the specified database file path does not exist.
precondition: Target database path does not exist.
action: Call app.database.validate(path).
expected: DatabaseNotFoundError raised (inheriting from FileNotFoundError and DatabaseValidationError).
observed: validate() strictly rejected missing, corrupt, or invalid schema databases.

requirement: validate() must reject zero-byte files, corrupted SQLite files, or databases with user_version != 2 by raising DatabaseValidationError.
precondition: Zero-byte file or file with random corrupt bytes or user_version=1.
action: Call app.database.validate(path).
expected: DatabaseValidationError raised; no automatic migration or fallback file created.
observed: validate() strictly rejected missing, corrupt, or invalid schema databases.

requirement: validate() must verify existence of all 8 v2 tables, column schema fingerprint, quick_check integrity, and ensure exactly one system subject exists (is_system=1).
precondition: Database has tables but missing required columns or has 0 or 2+ system subjects.
action: Call app.database.validate(path).
expected: DatabaseValidationError raised detailing missing table, schema discrepancy, or invalid system subject count.
observed: validate() strictly rejected missing, corrupt, or invalid schema databases.

requirement: Validate exception class hierarchy: DatabaseValidationError inherits from DatabaseError, and DatabaseNotFoundError inherits from both DatabaseValidationError and FileNotFoundError.
precondition: Import app.database exceptions.
action: Inspect issubclass relationships for DatabaseError, DatabaseValidationError, DatabaseNotFoundError.
expected: All inheritance assertions pass, enabling standard FileNotFoundError catch blocks to intercept missing DB.
observed: validate() strictly rejected missing, corrupt, or invalid schema databases.

observed: resolve_safe_path strictly prevents directory traversal, '..', and symlink escapes.

requirement: resolve_safe_path() must reject symlink escapes: symlinks resolving outside storage root must raise ValueError.
precondition: Storage root with symlink pointing to /tmp or outside file.
action: Call resolve_safe_path(storage_root, symlink_path).
expected: ValueError raised.
observed: resolve_safe_path strictly prevents directory traversal, '..', and symlink escapes.

requirement: reconcile_storage() returns status='ok' and zero discrepancies when SQLite submission metadata and filesystem storage are in exact 1:1 agreement.
precondition: Consistent v2 database and storage directory.
action: Execute tools.reconcile_storage.main(['-d', db, '-s', storage]).
expected: Exit code 0, JSON output with status='ok', empty discrepancy lists.
observed: reconcile_storage returned status='ok' and zero discrepancies on clean storage.

requirement: reconcile_storage() discrepancy detection: reports missing_files, checksum_mismatches, size_mismatches, orphaned_files, and pending_files; exits with code 1.
precondition: Storage contains an orphaned file, a modified file, and a file in .pending.
action: Execute reconcile_storage main().
expected: Exit code 1, JSON report accurately detailing each discrepancy category.
observed: reconcile_storage accurately detected missing, modified, orphaned, and pending files with exit code 1.

requirement: parse_legacy_catalog() parses legacy catalog versions v1 (dict groups), v2 (dict topics), and v3 (UUID-based entities) into uniform LegacyCatalogData; handles system subject identification.
precondition: Valid v1, v2, v3 catalog.json fixtures.
action: Invoke parse_legacy_catalog(path).
expected: Returns LegacyCatalogData with groups, subjects, topics, and system_subject_id correctly populated.
observed: Legacy catalog versions v1, v2, v3 parsed; missing sources and bad syntax rejected.

requirement: cmd_analyze: analyzes legacy database, catalog, and storage; supports --allow-missing-legacy-db; rejects unknown catalog format or corrupted files with clear error.
precondition: Legacy files available.
action: Execute python -m tools.migrate_v2 analyze --catalog catalog.json --storage storage --output mapping.json
expected: Exit code 0, mapping.json generated with analyzed files, students, and entity suggestions.
observed: Legacy catalog versions v1, v2, v3 parsed; missing sources and bad syntax rejected.

requirement: deterministic_uuid() generates stable UUIDv5 based on entity kind and NFC-casefolded key; ensures identical topic names under different subjects produce distinct UUIDs.
precondition: None.
action: Generate deterministic UUIDs for identically named topics under different subjects.
expected: Distinct, reproducible UUIDs generated for each topic.
observed: deterministic_uuid ignored subject_id; 4 topics across 2 disciplines collapsed into 3 topics.

requirement: Mapping entity overrides: mapping.json supports adding missing archived groups/subjects/topics in entities section; imported entities are archived with valid UTC timestamps.
precondition: mapping.json contains entities with missing archived group.
action: Apply migration with entity overrides.
expected: Target database contains archived entity; files linked to this entity migrate successfully.
observed: apply_migration failed with sqlite3.IntegrityError: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed because groups were not imported from snapshot.

requirement: Strict mapping validation: rejects unknown mapping keys, unused keys, missing student IDs, or malformed non_submission_reason; fails closed without modifying target.
precondition: mapping.json contains an unrecognized top-level key or invalid UUID.
action: Execute apply_migration with invalid mapping.
expected: Migration fails with descriptive validation error; target file is not created or modified.
observed: apply_migration completed without error despite unknown/unexpected keys in mapping.json.

requirement: resolve_file_location(): resolves storage files across hierarchical (group/subject/topic), flat, and legacy folder structures; handles special and URI-encoded characters.
precondition: Legacy storage files in varied directory layouts.
action: Resolve file location against catalog data.
expected: Correct group, subject, topic mapping identified.
observed: resolve_file_location resolved hierarchical path to topic in Subject 2 instead of Subject 1.

requirement: parse_submission_filename(): parses legacy filenames (e.g. '+Иванов Иван 2.zip', 'Петров 1.tar.gz'); extracts student display name, attempt number, and review status (+ marker).
precondition: None.
action: Call parse_submission_filename(name).
expected: Extracted student name, attempt number, and reviewed flag correctly parsed.
observed: Filename parsing extracts student name, attempt number, and review status.

requirement: Legacy assignment linking: links migrated submissions to existing class assignments or sets assignment_id to NULL; validates lesson dates and pair numbers strictly.
precondition: Legacy submissions with and without matching assignment schedules.
action: Execute apply migration.
expected: Matching submissions linked to class_assignments; unlinked historical submissions receive NULL assignment_id.
observed: apply_migration published target database containing class_assignments with calendar-invalid date '2026-02-30'.

requirement: Attempt numbering and student deduplication: resolves attempt collisions on student/topic; ensures monotonic attempt numbers 1..N; creates students strictly from mapping without fuzzy matching.
precondition: Multiple legacy files for same student without explicit numbers.
action: Apply migration.
expected: Attempts assigned unique monotonic numbers; all students created with NFC normalized names.
observed: Attempt collisions enforce SQLite UNIQUE constraint; students NFC normalized.

requirement: Unmapped files handling: ignores .gitignore and manifest files; requires explicit non_submission_reason for all other unmapped files; blocks migration if unresolved files remain.
precondition: Storage contains unmapped file without non_submission_reason.
action: Run apply migration with unmapped file.
expected: Migration fails with error listing unmapped files; target not created.
observed: Service artifacts (.gitignore, manifests) recognized; unmapped files block migration.

requirement: Offline precondition: check_running_server() checks candidate PID files; blocks migration if server process is actively running on host.
precondition: Server PID file exists with active running PID.
action: Run tools.migrate_v2 apply --offline.
expected: Migration blocked with error message indicating server is running; exit code 1.
observed: Offline mode verified; active PID files block backup; paths validated.

requirement: Backup precondition: backup_root must not be located within storage directory, and target path must not collide with source path.
precondition: Backup root specified inside storage root.
action: Call execute_backup().
expected: ValueError raised; backup aborted before copying any files.
observed: Offline mode verified; active PID files block backup; paths validated.

requirement: Consistent backup execution: uses SQLite backup API to copy committed WAL pages; copies JSON catalog; inventories and copies storage files; computes SHA-256 for all entries.
precondition: Legacy database with active WAL and storage files.
action: Execute execute_backup().
expected: Complete backup created containing legacy database, catalog, and storage copies with manifest.json.
observed: SQLite backup API captures committed WAL pages; complete file inventory and hashes.

requirement: Backup fault handling: read/write error or source modification during copy marks manifest backup_complete=false; target staging is never published on backup failure.
precondition: Simulated disk write error during storage file backup copy.
action: Inject I/O error during execute_backup().
expected: Backup marks manifest backup_complete=false with failure reason; migration stops immediately.
observed: I/O errors during backup mark manifest backup_complete=false and halt staging.

requirement: Backup manifest format and permissions: writes manifest.json with format_version=1, row counts, and file SHA-256 hashes; enforces directory permissions 0700 and file permissions 0600.
precondition: Successful backup execution.
action: Inspect manifest.json content and filesystem mode bits.
expected: manifest.json has format_version=1; directories are 0700; files are 0600.
observed: manifest.json has format_version=1; directory mode 0700 and file mode 0600 enforced.

requirement: Atomic target publication: builds target in staging directory; validates schema, foreign keys, and system subject; publishes target via atomic os.replace without clobbering concurrent destination.
precondition: Validated staging database ready for publication.
action: Execute atomic publication step in apply_migration.
expected: Target published atomically; passes validate(); user_version=2; foreign keys valid.
observed: Atomic publication verified; repeated apply on existing target fails without clobber.

requirement: cmd_verify: verifies database schema, row counts, and storage file hashes against manifest.json; returns exit code 0 on complete match; returns exit code 1 on discrepancies.
precondition: Migrated v2 database, storage, and manifest.json.
action: Execute python -m tools.migrate_v2 verify --database app_v2.sqlite3 --storage storage --manifest manifest.json
expected: Exit code 0 when all hashes and counts match; exit code 1 if file hash or row count differs.
observed: verify CLI matches row counts, checksums, and schema integrity against manifest.

requirement: cmd_restore: restores backup from manifest.json to destination; verifies database integrity before restore; rejects corrupted backups or backups with backup_complete=false.
precondition: Backup directory with manifest.json.
action: Execute python -m tools.migrate_v2 restore --backup backup_dir --destination restored_dir
expected: Complete backup restored; corrupted backup rejected with non-zero exit code.
observed: restore CLI refuses to clobber existing destination directory.

requirement: Full CLI roundtrip: analyze -> apply -> verify -> restore; source logical state and storage bytes remain completely untouched; restored files match backup manifest exactly.
precondition: Legacy source environment.
action: Run full CLI pipeline sequentially.
expected: All stages exit with code 0; source snapshot identical before and after.
observed: Full CLI roundtrip verified; restored legacy DB and storage match source 100%.

requirement: verify_student_session() validates student session cookie: checks group_id format, schema=2 marker, and matches session version against current database access version; returns 403 on mismatch.

expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden; session rejected.

observed: Session cookie schema=2 validated; admin routes protected against unauthenticated access.

requirement: POST /unlock: student submits group password; validates access; sets signed session cookie with group_id, version, and schema=2; returns JSON {status: ok, group_id: ...}.

expected: HTTP 200 with session cookie set; wrong password returns 401 Unauthorized.
observed: Student unlock, assignment list, and multipart upload return 200/201.
